extraction.name: EgoLife
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation, designed to develop an egocentric life assistant.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together in a custom-designed environment (EgoHouse) for seven days, recording daily activities including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment using AI glasses and synchronized third-person cameras.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multimodal egocentric video and signals from Meta Aria glasses, synchronized third-person video from 15 GoPro cameras, and spatial/motion data from mmWave radars and WiFi receivers.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data was synchronized using timestamps, desensitized by blurring faces and license plates, and muting sensitive audio. Videos were split into clips for annotation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Synchronization of multi-source data (video, audio, IMU) using EgoSync; privacy protection via EgoBlur (blurring faces/identifiers); dense captioning via EgoCaption; transcription via EgoTranscript.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcripts were generated via speech recognition and diarization, then reviewed. Captions were created by annotators narrating slowed-down video clips, merged using GPT-4o-mini, and expanded into visual-audio captions verified by humans. QA annotations were generated by GPT-4o and refined by human annotators who selected high-quality questions and created distractors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Capcut (video editing software with dubbing functions)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Whisper Large v3, open-source diarization algorithm
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Faces, voices, personal habits, health habits, interpersonal interactions, location data, private conversations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential to enhance human-AI interaction, personalized assistance, and context-aware applications. May improve quality of life for elderly or those with cognitive challenges. Raises privacy and ethical considerations regarding data privacy and user autonomy.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Primarily Chinese language and culture (Beijing dataset); single household environment; limited generalizability due to narrow setting.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limited to a single household and language (initially); identity recognition challenges; speech understanding limitations (e.g., laughter/emotions); potential overfitting to early observations for personalization; lack of multi-step reasoning in retrieval.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Specifically for developing robust visual-audio models for egocentric data, identity recognition, and long-context question answering.
